title: Autonomy score must not let historical soak override current runtime freshness
symptoms: autonomy_score reports stage4_confirmed after a daemon restart
uptime_hours in autonomy_score does not match the current daemon started_at and last_tick_at
soak_validation remains confirmed while current control layer or uptime has regressed
root_cause: tools/autonomy_score.py overwrote current uptime and stage with soak_validation.summary when soak_validation.confirmed was true, even if the current runtime had restarted or was no longer aligned with the historical soak snapshot.
policy: Current autonomy status must be computed from fresh daemon heartbeat and current uptime only.
Historical soak results may be reported as context, but must not override current runtime metrics or stage.
A running daemon without a fresh heartbeat must be treated as stale for autonomy scoring.
